summary: One-line fix swaps `intersect` (returns unevaluated Intersection) for `intersection` (evaluates), so `is_subset` correctly compares the evaluated intersection to `self`. Minimal, targeted, resolves the reported wrong `is_subset` results without touching unrelated code.

issues.description: Fix relies on `intersection` producing an evaluated set equal to `self`; for set pairs where evaluation cannot simplify, `is_subset` may still return None (falls through). Acceptable since the method returns None as 'unknown' by design and the pre-existing XXX comment already flags this approach as suboptimal.
